text:
Type: pair of light grey sheer curtains
Use: softening daylight and adding privacy at a window; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: lightweight semi-sheer woven fabric, rod pocket heading
Colors: light warm grey, greige
Shape: two long straight panels hanging in soft vertical folds from a rod pocket, gathered top, plain hem, light and flowing
Feel: soft, airy, calm, light
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen, grey sofas; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: VIVAN
product.description: The curtains let the daylight through but provide privacy so they are perfect to use in a layered window solution.
